scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A solemn man holds an oil lamp beside a breached mudbrick house. A cloaked, motionless figure lies among fallen bricks, with sandaled feet visible. A digging tool and tied sack rest nearby beneath a blue evening sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined aftermath relates the breached wall and digging tool to breaking in, and the covered, motionless figure to the thief's death. The householder, lamp, dim light and courtyard are artistic staging. The legal ruling of no bloodguilt remains in the explanation; the picture illustrates the case without showing the fatal blow.
